title: Factions
description: The armed powers and their starting relations (spec GEN-004..GEN-018, STR-051, STR-066, STR-067, STR-096, SAI-010). Relation range and thresholds are strategic-rules (STR-051), not faction fields. A record of kind resistance is the template every resistance group spawned during play uses (doctrine, squadTemplate); groups get their own IDs at creation (STR-067).

kind.description: GEN-004; resistance = template for spawned resistance groups (STR-067)

leaderEffect.description: GEN-008: values of the leader effect

protocolBreachReputation.description: Orlov (SSV): reputation change per protocol breach, design draft -5

letterChance.description: Sokolov (Varyag): chance per player soldier killed by Varyag, design draft 0.25

letterMinDays.description: Sokolov (Varyag): at most one letter per this many days, design draft 7

adaptation.description: Rook (Aegis): habit adaptation, optional and deferred (no AI memory in the first build iterations)

standingUnlocks.description: GEN-010 (Krug): minimum Krug reputation per unlock

resentment.description: GEN-010 (Krug record): Krug members resenting foreign soldiers

priceMarkup.description: extra share on Krug recruits and Krug deals for the player (price × (1 + priceMarkup), applied by MGT), design draft 0.10

escortRefusalChance.description: STR-094: chance per paid escort request by a foreign PMC that it is refused outright, design draft 0.20

backs.description: GEN-005, GEN-015 (influence records): the state this influence backs, design east → ssv, west → vdk

startRelations.description: GEN-007 / STR-051: faction id → relation at campaign start, symmetric (design draft table in GEN-007)

rogueDoctrine.description: SAI-002 / SAI-010 (rival PMC records): doctrine used once this PMC has gone rogue (STR-066)

squadTemplate.description: STR-096: size and gear tier of a squad this faction raises (not set)

measures.description: STR-070, desperate measures this faction may take

rogueChance.description: GEN-017 (Varyag and Aegis records): daily rogue chance = base + perSign × patron crisis signs + the bonuses that apply

patronLosingBonus.description: while the patron is losing (strategic-rules losing, STR-061), design draft 0.03

unpaidContractsBonus.description: per unpaid contract payment owed to it in the last unpaidWindowDays, design draft 0.02

unpaidContractsMax.description: cap of the unpaid-contracts rise, design draft 0.06

nearCapitalBonus.description: per region it controls within nearCapitalRange of the capital, design draft 0.01

nearCapitalRange.description: tiles from the capital, design draft 3

nearCapitalMax.description: cap of the near-capital rise, design draft 0.05
